description: Search the current user's tasks by free-text query, project, or context. By default only open (incomplete) tasks are searched; pass include_completed: true to also search completed and skipped tasks. Supports: plain text (e.g. 'dentist'), projects (e.g. '+work'), contexts (e.g. '@office'), due dates (e.g. 'due:today', 'due:overdue', 'due:2025-12-01'), negation (e.g. '!+archived'), OR groups (e.g. '+work || +personal'), and combined queries (e.g. '+work @office dentist').

include_completed.description: Set to true to also search completed and skipped tasks

name: search_tasks
